title: AI-Assisted Employee Badge Generation
subtitle: Prepare the portrait, apply trusted profile details and generate a print-ready employee badge.
scenario: Employee badges needed a consistent design and a simpler preparation process. Staff could use an authorized ID portrait or a separate headshot, but the original identity document had to remain private and the issued badge had to stay tied to the correct employee.
outcome: Reduce repetitive badge preparation while keeping names, titles, template layout, issued copies and employee access under application control.
flow: Select an authorized ID portrait or headshot
Prepare the portrait; keep source appearance
Render the fixed template using profile name and title
Validate exact artifact proofs and issue the badge
Reuse the saved copy for reprint; deny access after revocation
notes: The public portrait is an original code-drawn fictional illustration, not a real ID or an AI quality sample.
Actual TypeScript source rules and tests cover ownership, fingerprints, direct issuance, reprints and revocation.
The optional image-edit adapter is Off by default. No API key, real employee image or paid call is used by the demo.
boundary: Actual implementation rules plus a fictional print preview; no employee credential is issued here.
